entries.name: Аристотель
entries.prompt: Use case: character assets for a draggable ordering game in Sophia, a refined philosophy learning website. Create ONE isolated ancient Greek philosopher, FULL LENGTH standing, complete head, both hands, robes and both sandalled feet entirely inside frame, with 10 percent transparent margin above and below. Portrait canvas. Transparent alpha background, no environment, no floor rectangle, no pedestal, no text, no lettering, no labels, no frame. Cohesive premium illustrated realism, realistic human anatomy, fine softly painted texture matching classical limestone and olive Sophia illustrations. Soft diffuse warm light from upper left, low contrast, muted ivory, sage, olive, restrained ochre. Front three-quarter view, relaxed calm standing pose, balanced silhouette suitable for dragging as one game piece. Avoid extending arms beyond body width, keep hands close to torso. No cropped feet, no cut off head. Adult historical artistic interpretation, no modern clothes. Aristotle, man about 45, short wavy chestnut hair, neatly trimmed short brown beard, thoughtful face. Muted sandy cream Greek chiton with subdued dusty teal mantle over one shoulder. Holds a small closed parchment scroll low near his waist with one hand, other hand relaxed. Lean average build, dignified approachable expression.
